top_signals.title: Democratic Socialists Endorse Nithya Raman in Race for LA Mayor
top_signals.summary: The Democratic Socialists of America’s Los Angeles chapter endorsed City Councilmember Nithya Raman for LA mayor, casting aside some members’ earlier reservations and bringing its organizing heft to her effort to unseat Karen Bass.

top_signals.title: US and Canadian court data exposed in Thomson Reuters breach
top_signals.summary: Sealed court information and sensitive personal data were exposed in a breach of a Thomson Reuters records platform affecting courts in at least 12 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands and Canada.
